metadata.description: This document from Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology details the status of vacant seats for the BE-BTech programme counselling on 14th August 2026, highlighting limited availability in specific branches and outlining the schedule for candidates with a JEE Main percentile of 90 or above.

result.title: THAPAR INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY, PATIALA
result.summary: The partial document from Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology, Patiala, dated 14th August 2026, provides information about the status of vacant seats for the BE-BTech programme counselling scheduled on the same day at 3:30 PM. It lists the availability of seats for various branches under the General Category, indicating that most branches have no available seats (marked as NA), except for Electrical and Computer Engineering with 2 seats and Robotics and Artificial Intelligence with 4 seats. Additionally, the document outlines the counselling schedule for candidates with a JEE Main 2026 percentile of 90 or above, specifying a Zoom meeting join time of 3:15 PM and a counselling start time of 3:30 PM.
